fnol_text: My name is Zara Rasmussen and I live at 716 Ashford Avenue, Fairview, PA 16474. You can reach me on (555) 722-2276 or zara.rasmussen@example.com. We had a cloudburst on 22 September 2026. The drains in the street could not cope and surface water from the road came up the drive and into the ground floor through the front door. Policy HH-2024-00045. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Rasmussen on (555) 722-2276 to acknowledge the claim. Zara confirmed the loss date as 22 September 2026.
Site visit to 716 Ashford Avenue. Neighbour Marcus Vasquez was present and confirmed the timeline.
Zara sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
